plan.output: A one-page evidence checklist that records an app listing’s stated security signals and unanswered verification questions without declaring the app safe.
inputs: Operator-copied official badge or certification text
plan.trigger: A store operator is considering a Shopify app and supplies its public listing information.
steps: Record the listing URL and the operator-copied claims.
Separate claims attributed to the listing from independently verified details.
Mark each checklist field as present, absent from supplied materials, or unverified.
Draft questions for the operator to confirm with the vendor or platform.
Have the operator review the record; do not issue a security verdict.
plan.acceptanceCheck: Given a fictional listing with mixed supplied claims, confirm the checklist preserves attribution and labels unknown fields without converting them into a safety rating.
plan.humanBoundary: The operator supplies public materials, independently checks any official status, and makes the install decision; the proposed aid cannot certify security.

plan.output: A reviewed recovery-design worksheet for one interrupted synthetic agent run, listing checkpoint state, retry assumptions and idempotency questions.
plan.trigger: An agent developer provides one fictional or sanitized interrupted run for design review.
steps: Summarize the supplied run and identify the last known completed step.
List state that the operator says must survive a restart.
Mark every external side effect and whether it may repeat.
Draft checkpoint and retry questions without prescribing executable recovery.
Have an engineer review the assumptions and record unresolved decisions.
plan.acceptanceCheck: For a fictional run with one repeated side effect, check that the worksheet flags the repeat risk and leaves the recovery choice unresolved for engineer review.
plan.humanBoundary: An engineer defines state, authorizes retries, and validates idempotency; the worksheet neither runs agents nor changes production systems.

Useful state and retry behavior vary by agent and are not supplied in the post.

plan.output: A review brief listing possible app-store listing improvements and unanswered discoverability questions from operator-supplied app details.
plan.trigger: An app maker supplies one app listing and asks for ways to improve how people find it.
steps: Record the supplied listing text and intended audience.
Extract claims and terms already present in the listing.
Draft a short set of clarity and audience-match questions.
Suggest wording experiments as hypotheses, not proven ranking factors.
Have the maker review every suggestion before changing the listing.
plan.acceptanceCheck: With fictional listing details, verify that the brief separates observed listing text from suggestions and does not claim a change will improve downloads.
plan.humanBoundary: The maker supplies accurate listing materials, chooses any edits and checks outcomes; the brief cannot establish app-store ranking behavior or guarantee discovery.
